name: frappe_assistant_core
description: Node dev dependencies for commit-message linting. Pinned to commitlint v19 for older benches. The build script compiles FAC Chat and the Desk widget (chat/frontend), which requires Node >=22 on every bench, including Frappe v15. It reinstalls whenever package-lock.json is newer than the last install (node_modules/.package-lock.json), so an update that adds a dependency cannot build against a stale node_modules.

scripts.build: cd frappe_assistant_core/chat/frontend && { [ node_modules/.package-lock.json -nt package-lock.json ] || npm ci; } && npm run build
